comments.value: I would personally keep the notes private. Having the notes be public could very easily be abused and used to defame or slander someone.

details:
Idea is that I want a setup that when someone blocks a user, the ability to put a note on the user. You can have it be private, and only you can see it, or public, so everyone can see it, with your username next to it or with something like "Z. posted:" or "Anonymous posted:" and then the note. The way you can see the notes of a user would be via a button under the Gift VRC+ button, and it functions like a mini forum page, where you can scroll through all notes people have wrote when blocking this user that are public, including any private ones you left. You can only put a message there by blocking someone, and if you unblocked them, the message remains. You can edit any notes you've made, and only delete those you've made.
Goal of this is to help people not only remember why they blocked someone, but also help people, especially the younger players, know who is not safe to interact with and why. The notes don't have to be essay length, just something simple like "[user] posted: [person they blocked] was using an offensive avatar and harassed me." or "Anonymous posted: They kept drawing on my face." Even a note like "I don't like children." or "They harassed my friend." is enough. Just a quick, 255 character limit, note about why you blocked them.
This is also helpful for the game's devs, as there's just not enough manpower to tend to all of the awful people who play, but if people can put notes on the user's account that the user who's getting blocked cannot see/access in any form, will help people be aware of who they should avoid, especially for the younger players who may not understand the intentions of the older aged players.
title: I want an additional feature added to blocking people that'll help keep users more safe.
